smallDeals.title: Growth Share
smallDeals.description: Buy one growth-company share for $10. It pays no dividends or Payday income. Keep it for a future Market sale; the offer may be higher or lower than your entry price.

smallDeals.title: Dividend Basket
smallDeals.description: Buy a small income interest in a dividend-paying investment basket. It adds $2 at each Payday in this game; selling ends that income.

smallDeals.title: Tool Rental Share
smallDeals.description: Buy an income interest in a tool-rental service. It pays a fixed amount at Payday; equipment purchases and repair bills are not charged separately in this game.

smallDeals.title: Digital Templates
smallDeals.description: Buy an income interest in a catalogue of digital templates. Sales provide a fixed Payday payment; you do not create designs or pay separate hosting costs.

smallDeals.title: Parking Space
smallDeals.description: Buy an income interest in a rented parking space. It provides one fixed Payday payment and is sold as one investment when a Market offer arrives.

smallDeals.title: Laundry Share
smallDeals.description: Buy an income interest in a neighbourhood laundry. The fixed Payday amount has no separate utility or machine-maintenance bills in this game.

smallDeals.title: Storage Units
smallDeals.description: Buy an income interest in a small storage business. Rental receipts are combined into one fixed Payday payment; a sale transfers the whole investment interest.

smallDeals.title: Coffee Cart
smallDeals.description: Buy an income interest in a coffee-cart business. It pays a fixed amount at Payday without separate staffing or supply bills in this game.

smallDeals.title: 2/1 Condo
smallDeals.description: Buy an income-producing interest in a two-bedroom, one-bath condo. Rental income adds to your Payday receipts; borrowing to enter the deal creates a separate monthly interest bill.

smallDeals.title: 3/2 House
smallDeals.description: Buy a rental-income interest in a three-bedroom, two-bath house. The entry payment ties up cash until you sell; weigh its monthly income against financing costs and the cash you want to keep.

smallDeals.title: Vending Route
smallDeals.description: Buy an income interest in a vending-machine route. Sales provide a fixed monthly payment in this game; you do not manage stock or pay separate restocking bills.

smallDeals.title: Micro SaaS
smallDeals.description: Buy an income interest in a subscription software business. Customer subscriptions provide a fixed monthly payment in this game; there are no separate development or hosting bills.

bigDeals.title: Warehouse Rentals
bigDeals.description: Buy an income interest in warehouse rentals. Several rental receipts become one fixed Payday payment; the investment is sold together rather than unit by unit.

bigDeals.title: Car Wash
bigDeals.description: Buy an income interest in a car wash. Its Payday payment has no separate staffing or equipment bills; bank borrowing still adds a monthly interest expense.

bigDeals.title: Neighbourhood Shops
bigDeals.description: Buy an income interest in a group of shops. Rents are combined into one fixed Payday payment. Your entry cash remains invested until a Market sale.

bigDeals.title: Distribution Business
bigDeals.description: Buy an income interest in a distribution business. It pays a fixed amount at Payday; its large entry payment may leave less cash available for other events.

bigDeals.title: 4-Plex
bigDeals.description: Buy an income interest in a building with four rental homes. Their rental income is combined into one payment; the game treats this as one investment that is sold together.

bigDeals.title: Pizza Franchise
bigDeals.description: Buy an income interest in a pizza franchise. The monthly payment has no separate staffing or ingredient bills in this game. Its large entry payment can require substantial bank borrowing.
